import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
v=np.var(sigma)
forms = {
 'A': lambda p: p[0]*T**p[1] + p[2]*eps**p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]/T) + p[5]*np.exp(-p[6]*eps)*np.exp(p[7]*T),
 'B': lambda p: p[0]*T + p[1]*eps**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]/T) + p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*eps)*np.exp(p[6]*T),
 'C': lambda p: p[0]*T + p[1]*eps**p[2]*T**p[3] + p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*eps)*np.exp(p[6]*T)*T**p[7],
 'D': lambda p: p[0]*T + p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*eps)*np.exp(p[3]*T) + p[4]*eps**p[5]*T**p[6],
 'E': lambda p: p[0]*T + p[1]*eps**p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]/T) + p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*eps/T),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
for name,f in forms.items():
    best=None
    for _ in range(150):
        p0=rng.uniform(-2,2,8); 
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-sigma,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0, max_nfev=3000)
        except Exception: continue
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    print(name, np.mean(best.fun**2)/v, np.round(best.x,4))
